desc: Texture upscaling's cost (0.5.1 report, RTX 4090: 4x textures with a Paper Mario 64 ROM linked made cutscenes chug): the prologue's cutscenes from the letter to Rogueport's harbour (Goombella, the X-Nauts) with everything from Paper Mario 64 on and textures upscaled 4x, real timing ([upscale] lines, $TTYD_UPSCALE_LOG). The filter runs on Aurora's workers, a frame's end puts their results in within 1.5 ms and one new texture. Before: 9.6 s of the frames' own time upscaling, the longest frame 2.1 s, 29 frames of 4 ms or more; now 0.2-1.1 s in all and 6-18 frames of 4 ms or more on a machine running a dozen other games (its texture creation and uploads, slowed by the load). The limits leave room for a busy test machine (a dozen games at once): under 3 s in all, none of 250 ms or more, fewer than 40 frames of 4 ms or more
log_must_not: ^\[upscale\] total at .* on the frame's thread ([3-9]\d{3}|\d{5,})\.\d ms
^\[upscale\] total at .*, ([4-9]\d|\d{3,}) frames 4 ms or more
